cases.title: keeps resident bytes bounded by the chunk size, not the file size
cases.reason: Rename to the actual observed property: reads a large history in chunks smaller than 1 MiB. peakChunkBytes measures individual stream chunks, not resident or retained heap; preserve the assertion and correct the comment rather than claiming a memory bound it cannot prove.

cases.title: refuses a single record too large to frame
cases.reason: A real oversized JSONL record exercises the per-record framer bound independently of the accepted large total file.

cases.reason: Injects real file growth after descriptor stat, completing a torn record. Latest+grown item identities, three passes and one descriptor establish the retried proof and replay observe the same repaired snapshot.

cases.title: preserves the inconsistent result on a read error
cases.reason: The actual opened read stream is destroyed with a controlled error; result must remain inconsistent, with afterEach checking every opened handle closes.

cases.title: does not open a source without an anchor
cases.reason: Actual reader must reject the unproven boundary before opening/reading any transcript; this is an admission property with observed filesystem effects.
